section_intro: The school district is the largest share of every Pelham property tax bill. Village of Pelham taxes are {{fact:village-share-of-tax-bill}} of a resident's total bill (per Mayor Mullen, Pelham Examiner May 2026). Pelham Manor has not published an equivalent figure.
note: Note: Only the Village of Pelham share ({{fact:village-share-of-tax-bill.short}}, Mayor Mullen/Examiner) has a source. The school district has no published percentage; the school bar is illustrative. The median Village of Pelham bill for FY2026-27 is {{fact:village-median-tax-fy2627}} — a median, so not comparable with the like-for-like figures above.

explainers.title: School District
explainers.description: FY2026-27 PUFSD budget: {{fact:school-budget-fy2627}}, voter-approved May 2026. Tax levy rose {{fact:school-levy-increase-fy2627}} — at state cap. Voters approved Props 1 & 2 of {{fact:school-bond-total}} capital bond in May 2025.

explainers.title: Westchester County
explainers.description: County funds regional services — health, parks, social services. Your 14th District legislator advocates for Pelham's share.

explainers.title: Village of Pelham
explainers.description: Village taxes fund police, fire, garbage, roads, water and the building department. The Village of Pelham passed a {{fact:village-budget-fy2627}} budget ({{fact:village-budget-increase-fy2627}} increase) for FY2026-27, overriding the state tax cap.

explainers.title: Village of Pelham Manor
explainers.description: Pelham Manor runs its own police, fire and public works. Its FY2026-27 budget is {{fact:manor-budget-fy2627}} with a {{fact:manor-tax-increase-fy2627}} tax increase, under the state cap.

explainers.title: Town of Pelham
explainers.description: Smallest share — covers courts, assessor, recreation, library, and ambulance service shared between both villages.

comparison.title: Village of Pelham vs Village of Pelham Manor
comparison.subtitle: Village tax on the same $1,045,204 assessed value
comparison.note: On the same assessed value the Village of Pelham bill is 12.8% higher. Village tax only — school, county and town taxes are billed on top of this. Source: Pelham Examiner, letter to the editor, January 2026.

unverified.title: County and town

items.label: Westchester County
items.text: No published share of a Pelham bill

items.label: Town of Pelham
items.text: Smallest share — often put at ~3–5%, with no published source

unverified.note: There is no verified estimate of the county tax on a Pelham bill, so this page does not give one. Your own bill lists every line: check it, or call the Town Receiver of Taxes on {{fact:town-receiver-phone}} for your breakdown.
